verdict.rationale: Pomelo's docs show it goes well beyond a single prepaid rail: tokenization covers Mastercard and Visa credit, debit and prepaid cards, and a credit core manages the full credit-line lifecycle from creation through authorization, collections and delinquency. Multi-app can combine two card types on one plastic. However, nothing separates commercial from consumer credit programs, and all evidence is vendor docs. Missing for 10: explicit commercial (business) credit program support, explicit consumer credit program positioning, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, the platform supports the card types my product needs — debit, prepaid, commercial credit, and consumer credit programs — not just one prepaid rail

citations.quote: nuestra solución de Tokenización está disponible para tarjetas Mastercard y Visa de crédito, débito o prepagas
Controla todo el ciclo de vida del crédito: desde la creación de la línea, pasando por la autorización de operaciones, hasta la cobranza y gestión de mora.
Es posible combinar dos tipos de tarjeta en un mismo plástico usando nuestra solución de Multi-app.
